d:
Vaishali men nitish setu ke udghatan ke mauke par chirag pasvan ke damdar bhashan ne sabka dhyan khinch liya. chirag ki baton se pradhanmantri narendr modi bhi prabhavit najar aae aur taliyan bajakar unka utsah barhaya. dekhie chirag pasvan ke bhashan ka yah khas pal aur janie kyon charcha men hai unka andaj.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
